feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 28 October 2026 6:15am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds at first.


##Wind)##

SW 6 or 7, soon decreasing West or SW 5 or 6 in morning, 4 or 5 in the afternoon, then 3 or 4 in the evening. Backing South 3 or 4 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Moderate or rough, becoming moderate this morning, then slight in the evening.


##Weather)##

A few outbreaks of rain and drizzle at first, but otherwise fair.


##Visibility)##

Mainly good, falling moderate or poor in any rain and drizzle at first.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 14°C
##Sea Temperature##

14°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds developing.


##Wind)##

South 3 or 4, increasing South or SE 4 or 5 through morning and afternoon, occasionally 6 to west of island. Becoming generally South or SE 5 or 6 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate, then mainly moderate later.


##Weather)##

Fair, then patchy drizzle for a time.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in any drizzle.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 15°C
##Sea Temperature##

14°C

##Warnings)##

Strong winds at first.


##Wind)##

South or SE 5 or 6, steadily decreasing South 3 or 4, then becoming Variable 2 or 3 overnight.


##State of sea)##

##Weather)##

##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in any rain later.


##Temperature##

14°C
